*Soundscape index metrics*

Using files cleaned of wind, rain, and device glitches, we computed six of the most common acoustic indices used for biodiversity monitoring from the ‘soundecology’ package in R (Villanueva-Rivera and Pijanowski, 2018 soundecology), as multi-index studies with these indices have been shown to be more effective than single index investigations

*Habitat metrics*

A 100m radius circular plots was established for each ARUs positions using Google Earth ( )..
The Hard Surface area (HSA) and open herbaceous cover (HERB) was estimated drawings polygon to estimate surfaces inside each circular plots.
